title: Sajda Wafa Pei Kardi Abbas Bawafa Nu
body:
Akhiyan Ich Teer Lagiya (x2) Haye Zahra Di Dua Nu
<<DIVIDER>>
Aisi Wafa Na Waikhi Sajday Ich Turr Gayian
Khaliq Di Bandagi Nun Karbal Ich Bhul Gayian
Ghazi Nay Injh Da Maniya (x2) Shabbir Di Raza Nu
<<DIVIDER>>
Mazloom Pyaasiya Nun Ghazi Na Waikh Sakiya
Shabbir Badshah Day Kaadman Ich Sirr Nun Rakhiya
Maan Jawo Hun Tay Mola (x2) Nokar Di Iltejah Nu
<<DIVIDER>>
Dhora
“Dastoor Honda-e-Sawaran Da, Landhay Ghot Day Vich
Hath Pakay, Tun Keewain Latha Hosay Ghazi Veeran
Hathay Dou Bazoo Katwa Kay, Awaaz Aaya Eh Pehla
Saar Jhaniya,phir Phaas Pair Rakab Eh, Mekku Babay
Aan Lahaya Eh, Vichon Najaf Ashraf Day Aakay”
<<DIVIDER>>
Jung Laye Ijaztan Nay Bas Paani Lain Jana
Fateh-e-Khaybar Da Bachra Nay Waar Tu Wakhana
Haar Jah Tay Saada Kabza (x2) Das Daywin Ashkiya Nu
<<DIVIDER>>
Rab-e-Wafa Nay Paani Taliyan Tay Jud Si Chaya
Paani Ton Pyaasa Asghar Ghazi Nun Nazar Aaya
Karkay Nigah Falaq Waal (x2) Takda-e-kibriya Nu
<<DIVIDER>>
Nad-e-Ali Nun Parda Raiya Teer Da Chipawan
Kat Gaiyan Bin Jung Day Abbas Diyan Bawan
Kaar Yaad Ghazi Roya (x2) Zainab Teri Rida Nu
<<DIVIDER>>
Chal Naal Meray Ghazi Adil Hussain Akhay
Roway Gi Khud Sakina Teri Laash Seenay Lakay
Maqtal Ich Chad Main Jawan (x2) Keewein Teray Jaye Bhira Nu
